title: Light and dark
summary: Show RetailOps in light or dark colours, or follow your device.

items: **Website**: open your user menu, then **Appearance**: System, Light or Dark. System follows your computer's setting.
**App**: More › Account › **Appearance**. The app starts in Dark.

blocks.text: Your choice is remembered on that browser or phone. It only changes what you see, not anyone else.
Your store's own colour is used in both, adjusted so text always stays easy to read.
